cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧。

cues.en: The idea of DRI, which stands for Do not repeat yourself.
cues.zh: DRY，Don't Repeat Yourself，不要重複自己。

cues.en: Functions are really, really useful when you have things that you want to do over and over.
cues.zh: 有事情想一做再做時，函式很有用。

cues.en: For example, the print function, we've used it a lot.
cues.zh: 例如 print，已經用了很多次。

cues.en: Imagine if we had to code that ourselves every single time and say what print function does.

cues.en: Luckily, Python gives us a print because it's such a useful tool.
cues.zh: 幸好，Python 提供這個實用工具。

cues.en: But if in our program we want to say hello multiple times and you can imagine this actually being a lot more complicated, maybe ten lines of code.
cues.zh: 但如果程式要打招呼多次，而且可能複雜得多，例如有十行程式，

cues.en: Instead of writing those ten lines of code over and over, I can just define it as a function and use it anywhere I want in my program.
cues.zh: 就不必反覆寫那十行，只要定義成函式，在程式裡需要時使用。

cues.en: Functions allow us to keep our code dry.
